cases.situation: I own a dog grooming salon. 2-star Google review from 'Kelly M.' saying her poodle waited 3 hours past pickup time and nobody called her. That's true, our groomer was out sick and we were behind.
cases.reply: Thank you for this, Kelly, and I'm sorry: a three-hour delay with no call isn't how we want anyone's day to go, and Coco deserved better too. We were a groomer down that day and didn't tell customers, which is on us. We now call everyone the moment we're running more than 30 minutes behind. I'd like to make it right; please email me at hello@pawsandsuds.com. Dana, owner
cases.note: Own it in one line, say what changed, move the fix offline. No compensation in public.

cases.situation: 小さなカフェを経営しています。食べログに「店員が無愛想で水も出てこなかった」と星1のレビュー。その日は確かに混んでいてお冷を出すのが遅れました。
cases.reply: ご来店いただき、率直なご感想をありがとうございます。混雑していた日とはいえ、お冷をお出しするのが遅れ、ご不快な思いをさせてしまい申し訳ありませんでした。混雑時は席にご案内した時点でお冷をお出しするよう、スタッフ全員で徹底しました。よろしければ info@komorebi-cafe.jp までご連絡ください。店主 佐藤
cases.note: 謝罪は一度だけ、変えたことを具体的に書き、続きは個別に。反論はしない。

cases.situation: Airbnb host here. Guest left a 1-star review saying we 'hid' the $75 cleaning fee and the place had no parking. The fee is in the booking breakdown and the listing says street parking only.
cases.reply: Thanks for the feedback, Jordan, and I'm sorry the stay didn't match what you expected. One small correction for anyone reading: the cleaning fee is shown in the price breakdown before booking, and the listing notes street parking only. I've added the parking detail to the top of the description so it's harder to miss. If anything else was off, I'd like to hear it. Rosa
cases.note: Correct the facts once, calmly, for the next readers. If they post again, reply once more, shorter, and stop.

cases.situation: 我开了一家口腔诊所。有位患者在大众点评给了一星，说拔智齿后疼了三天，医生不负责、不接电话。病历上看恢复是正常的，但我不能在公开平台说他的诊疗细节。
cases.reply: 感谢您写下这次的经历，拔牙后疼了三天确实很难受，术后电话没能及时接通也是我们的问题。出于对患者隐私的保护，我们不在公开平台讨论具体诊疗情况，但我很想亲自了解您现在的恢复。我是诊所负责人陈立新医生，您可以直接打我的电话 0571-8826 3310，工作日9点到18点我都在，需要的话我们安排免费复查。陈立新
cases.note: Medical and legal settings: never confirm treatment details in public; own the phone issue, move the rest offline.

cases.situation: I run a plumbing company. I replied politely to a 2-star review from 'Derek P.' about a technician arriving late. He's now edited it to 1 star, calling our reply 'corporate BS' and saying his leak still isn't fixed.
cases.reply: Derek, I'm sorry this still isn't fixed. I've sent you a direct message with my mobile number, and I can have a technician at yours tomorrow morning if that suits. Luis, owner.
cases.note: The second public reply is shorter than the first; don't defend the first one, and move everything else to private.

cases.situation: Tengo un restaurante de arroces en Valencia. Un tal Marcos nos ha puesto una estrella en Google diciendo que la paella del domingo 20 estaba cruda y que el camarero se rió de ellos. Ese domingo estuvimos cerrados por vacaciones y no hay ninguna reserva a su nombre.
cases.reply: Hola, Marcos. Gracias por contarlo: una paella cruda y un trato así serían inaceptables en nuestra casa. Una aclaración para quien lea esto: el domingo 20 de septiembre estuvimos cerrados por vacaciones, así que creo que esta reseña puede ser de otro restaurante. Si me equivoco, escríbeme a reservas@labarracadepepa.es y lo hablamos en persona. Pepa, propietaria.
cases.note: Se corrige el dato una sola vez, con calma y sin llamarle mentiroso; si parece falsa, se denuncia a Google aparte y se deja esta respuesta.

cases.situation: 我开了一家卖手工陶瓷杯的淘宝店。有个买家给了差评，说杯子寄到时碎了，“包装太敷衍”。外箱是被快递压扁的，但我们的包装确实只有一层气泡膜。
cases.reply: 谢谢您把照片发上来，收到一只碎掉的杯子，换谁都会失望。外箱是在运输途中被压坏的，但杯子是在我们店买的，就该由我们负责。新杯子今天已经寄出。从这周起，所有杯子都改成双层气泡膜加纸格固定。后续有任何问题，旺旺直接找我。店主 阿禾
cases.note: 快递的问题只陈述一次，然后把责任接过来；包装确实能改进，就写出具体改了什么，其余私下处理。
